name: editorial
description: The agent's side of a CMS whose content is files: skills that add, write, review, retire and report on the content of a site built from files, with the site's own voice rules read from the repo, never from the plugin

interface.shortDescription: Write, review and manage the content of a site whose content is files.
interface.longDescription: The editor of a site built on agentic-cms: pages, posts, authors, reviews and FAQ sets are files under content/, validated on every build. The skills add a page or a post, write one from a brief in gated stages, update or retire one without breaking an indexed URL, review a file against the site's own voice and claim rules, fact-check a draft against primary sources, and report what is live, in draft and planned. Everything a brand owns is read from the repo the agent is standing in; the plugin carries none of it.
defaultPrompt: Report the state of the site's content.
Review content/blog/<slug>.md against the voice rules.
Write a post from the next brief in content/editorial/backlog.md.
